name: lumenva-crm
description: Lumenva — sistema operacional de vendas open source com agentes de IA nativos e WhatsApp (WAHA). Self-hosted, multi-tenant, RGPD by-design.

scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && NODE_ENV=test pnpm test:unit && pnpm lint:tenant-filter && pnpm lint:channels && next build
scripts.build:docker: pnpm typecheck && NODE_ENV=test pnpm test:unit:docker-build && pnpm lint:tenant-filter && pnpm lint:channels && next build
scripts.test:unit:docker-build: pnpm test:unit --exclude tests/unit/env-example-sync.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/env-alias.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/openrouter-alcance.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/voice-qa-harness-contract.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/e2e-workflow-honra-o-env.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/evidencia-citada.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/n8n-inbound-contract.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/n8n-reference-workflow.test.ts
scripts.gov:verify: pnpm harness:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm lint:channels && pnpm lint:tenant-filter && pnpm test:unit
scripts.phase7:inngest: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-real-runtime.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-sdk-wiring.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-route.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-public-path.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-batch-runner.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-local-dispatcher.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-local-command.test.ts && pnpm typecheck && tsx scripts/phase7-inngest-benchmark.ts
scripts.phase7:benchmark:all: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/durable-benchmark-provider-report.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-current-provider.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-provider.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-vercel-workflow-provider.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-vercel-workflow-local-runtime.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-vercel-workflow-public-path.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-comparative-orchestrator.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-all-command.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-real-runtime.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-sdk-wiring.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-route.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-public-path.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-batch-runner.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-local-dispatcher.test.ts tests/unit/durable-benchmark-inngest-local-command.test.ts && pnpm typecheck && tsx scripts/phase7-benchmark-all.ts
